description: The image displays two separate bar charts, both measuring Fleiss Kappa values along a vertical axis ranging from 0.0 to 0.8 in increments of 0.2, with each bar labeled with its exact value. The right chart shows Fleiss Kappa against “Max Ambiguity,” with the horizontal axis presenting three integer categories labeled 1, 2, and 3; the corresponding bar heights and values are 0.89, 0.46, and 0.23 respectively. All bars are rendered in a uniform dark teal color and are positioned without grouping or stacking, with no visual emphasis such as shading or bolding applied to any bars. Neither chart indicates a specific sorting order for the bars along the horizontal axis.
